title: MOTION (PARK - PRICE) relative to funding for the design, management, and construction of the Revitalize Rose Avenue Pedestrian Connectivity and…
text:
[Council File 26-1643; CD 11]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (PARK - PRICE) relative to funding for the design, management, and construction of the Revitalize Rose Avenue Pedestrian Connectivity and Beautification Project.
Recommendations for Council actions, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE that $1,028,322.98 from the Coastal Transportation Corridor Fund No. 447-94, Account No. 9426NT (Westside Fast Forward Streets LA Sidewalk Projects-Coastal), to Bureau of Street Services Fund No. 100-86 as outlined in the Motion, attached to the Council file, for the design, management, and construction of the Revitalize Rose Avenue Pedestrian Connectivity and Beautification Project.
2. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE that $21,706.02 from the Coastal Transportation Corridor Fund No. 447-94, Account No. 9426NT (Westside Fast Forward Streets LA Sidewalk Projects-­Coastal), to Bureau of Street Lighting Fund No. 100-84 as outlined in the Motion, attached to the Council file, for work on the Revitalize Rose Avenue Pedestrian Connectivity and Beautification Project.
3. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE that $225,169.48 from the Coastal Transportation Corridor Fund No. 447-94, Account No. 94186C (Bureau of Street Services), to Bureau of Street Services Fund No. 100-86, Account No. 001010 (Salaries, General) for work on the Revitalize Rose Avenue Pedestrian Connectivity and Beautification Project.
4. TRANSFER and APPROPRIATE that $55,445 from the Coastal Transportation Corridor Fund No. 447-94, Account No. 94184C (Bureau of Street Lighting), to Bureau of Street Lighting Fund No. 100-84 as outline in the Motion, attached to the Council file, for work on the Revitalize Rose Avenue Pedestrian Connectivity and Beautification Project.
5. AUTHORIZE that the Bureau of Street Services to make any corrections, clarifications or revisions to the above fund transfer instructions, including any new instructions, in order to effectuate the intent of this Motion, and including any corrections and changes to fund or account numbers; said corrections / clarifications / changes may be made orally, electronically or by any other means.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Council would transfer and appropriate Coastal Transportation Corridor funds to design, manage and build the Revitalize Rose Avenue pedestrian connectivity and beautification project.

details.bureau: Bureau of Street Services and Bureau of Street Lighting
